kevin.l: quick note — hit misleading ApiError in node SDK: message says 'unauthorized' but http status was 429 so worker retried wrong path.
sara.m: oh no. That will confuse onboarding scripts. We need clear mapping and fields on the exception.
michael_p: Suggestion: keep ApiError as base, add subclasses AuthError(401), PermissionError(403), RateLimitError(429, retry_after), TransientError(5xx). All errors should expose http_status (int) and human_action (short string).
kevin.l: +1. human_action could be used by sample-apps for quickstart copy. e.g. "refresh token" or "contact admin / check scopes".
sara.m: Also add a lint/test in sample-apps that fails if example code string-matches 'unauthorized' — encourage instance-of or http_status checks instead.
devex-bot: created DE-2111: "sdk: error subclasses + http_status + human_action" assigned to @michael_p.
michael_p: I'll draft a one-pager with the exception hierarchy, fields (http_status, retry_after, human_action), and example catch patterns for Py/Node/Go. Will ping for review.
